claim: In November 2026, major industry events included Anthropic opening its IPO roadshow, Jensen Huang stepping down at Nvidia, Google launching Gemini 4 Hydrogen, United Airlines restricting AI booking agents, and EU leaders meeting in Dublin.
note: Synthesis of the week's five covered developments across posts and sources 1 through 5.

claim: Anthropic launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering on November 10, 2026, with an expected price between $70.00 and $78.00 per share.

support.quote: Today Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock.
The initial public offering price is expected to be between $70.00 and $78.00 per share.

claim: Nvidia announced on November 12, 2026, that Jensen Huang resigned as president and CEO effective immediately.

support.quote: NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) Board of Directors announced today that Jensen Huang has resigned as President, Chief Executive Officer, and a member of the Board, effective immediately.

claim: Google expanded its model portfolio on November 12, 2026, by launching Gemini 4 Hydrogen for coding and agent workflows.

claim: United Airlines updated its digital policies on November 11, 2026, to prohibit unauthorized third-party personal AI assistants.

support.quote: United Airlines today announced updates to its digital policies to protect customers and address cybersecurity, privacy and consumer protection concerns raised by unauthorized, third-party personal artificial intelligence (AI) agents or assistants.
